definitions: A deer, Odocoileus virginianus, family Cervidae, perhaps the most popular game animal in North America.
Any of the white-tailed spiders of genus Lampona (Lampona cylindrata and Lampona murina) native to eastern and southern Australia.

blocks.text: Whitetail is a small, unincorporated village in northern Daniels County, Montana, United States. As of the 2020 census, Whitetail had a population of 9.
Whitetail Mountain Resort is a four-season resort located on Two Top Mountain, a mountain in the Bear Pond Mountains of Pennsylvania.

Whitetail is a 2025 drama film directed by Nanouk Leopold starring Natasha O’Keeffe. The film premiered at the 2025 Toronto International Film Festival. Set in the southern Irish countryside, the film follows a woman as she grapples with a past tragic trauma.
